data.source_title: CMS Emergency room rights under EMTALA
data.locator: “Give you an appropriate medical screening exam”; insurance inquiry must not delay exam/treatment; uninsured patients still offered screening.
data.source_setting: US hospital emergency-care context described by CMS
data.quantity: Insurance inquiry cannot delay emergency care
data.value: Insurance questions may be asked only without delaying examination or treatment; screening is offered even without insurance.
data.source_evidence_basis: CMS EMTALA rights page states that a hospital may ask about insurance at check-in only if doing so does not delay the medical screening exam or treatment, and must offer screening even to uninsured patients.
data.limitations: This is a plain-language CMS summary of EMTALA protections, not a complete legal analysis or benefit/payment determination. Applies to emergency departments within EMTALA scope.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Do not place insurance authorization as a gate before emergency screening/stabilization in the simulation; allow parallel administrative work.
